fund.lede: OpenRig has no company behind it and nothing to sell you. It stays free and open source either way — money decides how fast it moves and how many machines it runs on.
fund.c1.p: Audio interfaces, footswitches and a Windows and a Linux machine to build and test on. Right now it's whatever is already in the room.
fund.c2.p: Capture packs, licences and studio time to model amps properly instead of guessing.
fund.c3.p: Every hour funded is an hour on OpenRig instead of on something else.
fund.note: No tiers, no paywalled features, no "pro" version. Ever.
dl.lede: OpenRig is free and open source. Download it, open it and start playing — nothing to sign up for, nothing to unlock later.
